title: Forming the 12-piece band and falling ill
summary: Sam builds a twelve-piece band, gets bookings at the Vanguard and Gulliver's and a contract, then takes sick.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Up until now and then after this we stayed in Europe. Got tired of Europe. So I figured I wanted to do something different, man. Put a band together, not a small band. I wanted to put in a 12-piece band together. And everybody say you crazy man. I say that's right, I'm crazy; but I'm going to do it.

And everybody didn't think I was going to do it but I did it. Man I came home and thought about it and knew what kind of sound that I wanted. Different, it wouldn't be no Count Basie stuff. It would be a different kind of band - jazz. I figured that 12 people voiced right, we could play jazz music man with that many pieces and work. I got the musicians together to start rehearsing and I didn't have no

problem getting musicians because when the news got around that I was getting ready to do this thing, then the musicians said hey man, I'm available, you know. So I didn't have to really look for any musicians. Guys was here. So, we started rehearsing. And I didn't know anything, like the band jumped up off the ground and all of a sudden you know here I (Village) am in the Vanguard playing in Thad Jones' place, you know. And the band was a hit and everybody liked it, you know. And before I know it, now I'm getting bookings. People want to book the band. Up in Massachusetts, in Hartford, in Baltimore, all around, places, you know. Then this guy here at Gulliver's said "you can play here on Tuesday nights as long as you want." So=I said, goddamn. I'm like swimming in the head, it went so fast. So everything was just about to get ready to.... And then this record company gave me a record contract, recorded the band. And we were just getting ready to go to California and then going to Japan.
And then I took sick. So that's where I'm at right now. That's at this point.
